detail.longDescription: Practitioner Disciplines That Separate Profitable AI From Expensive AI A field guide for Chief AI Risk Officers, CTOs, auditors, and general counsels who own what happens after the model ships A model that hits 96 percent accuracy in validation can still lose an organization eight figures in its first year of production. That gap, between a model that scores well and a model that actually pays off, is where most AI programs quietly fail.
